probe_model_activations: use AutoProbeD as a context manager to probe and log tensor activations of a PyTorch model during forward and backward passes
log_custom_tensor_stats: use log_stats to log statistics of a custom tensor at any point in the model forward pass
compute_attention_stats: use _compute_attn_stats_sdpa to compute and log attention logits and entropy for SDPA-based attention layers
probe_flash_attention_stats: use _compute_attn_stats_flash to compute and log attention logits and entropy for xFormers flash attention layers
get_tensor_statistics: use _get_stats to compute shape, mean, std, skew, kurtosis, and quantile statistics for a PyTorch tensor
